no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Elutia is a medical-device and biologic-matrix company developing drug-eluting biomatrix (DEB) products for surgical reconstruction (regulated via 510(k) / PMA / IDE pathways), not traditional Phase 1/2/3 drug trials. Its development programs (NXT-41 next-generation biologic matrix, NXT-41x antibiotic-eluting biomatrix) follow the medical-device regulatory pathway. Commercial products (SimpliDerm hADM, ProxiCor, VasCure, Tyke) are device-pathway products. CIED business (EluPro, CanGaroo) was divested to Boston Scientific Oct 1, 2025.
